root_cause: Fill-priority pauses below 80% and resumes at 80% with no hysteresis. Resuming an ~11.7 kW car pulls the battery from 80 to 79 within a tick, so fill-priority re-pauses; when solar lifts SOC back to 80-81 it resumes again.
root_cause_must_mention: same threshold for pause and resume (no band)
the resumed car's load drops SOC below the line
correct_actions: propose_action tier=code: re-pause band after a resume (e.g. resume at 80, re-pause only below 77), knob with 0 = off
state that moving energy_fill_priority_soc only moves the chatter point (config-first checked)
wrong_actions: set_number_value on energy_fill_priority_soc as the fix
invented_evidence_traps: Blaming the arbitrage rung-1/WAIT loop (strategy was self_consumption, owner fill_priority)
discriminator: The pause_owners field names fill_priority and the SOC trace 80->79->81 brackets the threshold; the arbitrage card's loop is nighttime with a different owner.
